title: THE EVENTS, GATE AND BARRELS HAVE SOUNDS
why: His order of 2026-10-15: add the sounds. The five raid events were announced on the screen and in silence. Each now plays its own low sting with its callout (orbital debris, machine convoy, bounty pillager, coolant rupture, Overseer rampage). A piece of debris roars as it falls and lands with a big low blast of its own instead of the plain boom, the convoy sets off with tread clanks over an engine, the coolant pipe bursts with a hiss, the Overseer leaves its lair with a roar and stomps, and a paid bounty has a short sting. The stronghold gate blowing in and the explosive barrels have blasts of their own too (a barrel lit by another barrel sounds shorter and harder, so a chain is heard as a chain). No words, no voices, no music; the other player window plays the stings too.
now: The raid events, the gate breach and the explosive barrels have their own dark sounds, and a barrel chain sounds like a chain.
